items.title: Tennessee halts executions after Christa Pike survives two lethal injection attempts
items.description: Pike had been on death row since she was convicted in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

items.title: What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?
items.description: The convicted killer is in hospital in Tennessee after surviving two lethal injections, in a case that has raised many questions.

items.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
items.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

items.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
items.description: Vladimir Putin insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

items.title: Trump's AI rebrand causes 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names
items.description: The president wants AI to be called super intelligence - or SI - the same initials used by Slovenian domains.

items.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
items.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

items.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
items.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.

items.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
items.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.

items.title: Fires break out at French schools as students protest nationwide
items.description: The French government holds a crisis meeting as demonstrations grow and become violent in places.

items.title: Kanye West's Russia shows officially cancelled after weeks of uncertainty
items.description: Chaos has surrounded the St Petersburg shows since the stadium said it had not agreed to host the rapper.

items.title: Algeria introduces death penalty for arsonists after deadly wildfires
items.description: It is estimated more than 200 people have died in blazes in the north-east of the country over the summer.

items.title: K-pop star convicted of violating military service law
items.description: The member of K-pop band Winner was given a suspended prison sentence for repeated absences from his national service work.

items.title: Swiss glaciers suffer 'disastrous' year of ice loss, threatening water supplies
items.description: Scientists say such rapid melting is no longer surprising given the pace of climate change.

items.title: Explosions heard in Ethiopia's capital after drone flights banned
items.description: It comes a week after fighting erupted north of the capital between the army and a new alliance of armed groups.

items.title: Cornell case highlights 'draining' maze for victims to report campus sex assaults
items.description: Victims often have to navigate both university and local law enforcement processes to find justice.

items.title: Tiny image sparks big backlash in Nikon photo contest
items.description: Dr Ning Xu denies he broke the rules of Nikon's annual Small World In Motion contest.

items.title: California bans child marriage, a practice still legal in 32 US states
items.description: Gov Gavin Newsom called it a "long overdue measure to protect young Californians".

items.title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
items.description: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.

items.title: Flydubai passenger describes hugging his children as plane nosedived during attack
items.description: Adam Polovincik tells the BBC he told his young children "everything is going to be all right" as flight plunged more than 17,000ft (5,200m).

items.title: Who is the 'hero' Indian pilot who was stabbed on Israel-bound flight?
items.description: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.
